about_the_game:
Enjoy a captivating Match - 3 adventure in Halloween Trouble 7: The Apprentice.

When witch Ronida suddenly disappears, and the magical mushrooms once again start creating trouble for the hapless town of Jamberton, the only person who can help save the town is the witch’s apprentice, Diamante.

Match gems, solve puzzles and complete quests as you help her solve the mystery of disappearance of her mentor and save Jamberton from the mischief of the magical mushrooms.

The game features a mix of Match-3 puzzles, Hidden Object Challenges, Jigsaws, Sliders, Memory games and a story full of humor, heart, and magical twists.

Can you help the apprentice outwit her unknown adversary, save her swamp, and finally earn her rightful name?

CE Edition Extras

Purple Swamp Campaign (50 More Levels)

Although Wizard Sahruk was defeated, Jamberton’s troubles are far from over. This time the magic feels wilder—older, deeper, and far more dangerous. The witches of Jamberton are about to face their greatest challenge yet...

Features

  • A story packed to the brim with wit and charm

  • Feel the Halloween spirit!

  • Match 3 gameplay that is just right - not too easy, not too hard

  • Hidden Object, Chain Solitaire, Slider, Jigsaw minigames

  • 100 levels of fun

  • Gameplay options can be changed anytime
